status: prepared linkage correction after the first compiled wheel fails Python import before CPU requests
scope: One bounded routing-history constant in a private build of Router0.1.16. No upstream contribution, official release, new runtime subsystem, full Program admission/resume or model arithmetic change.

source_archive.source_change: Only CacheAwareConfig default history limit changes from 10000 to 8388608 characters per target. Native eviction interval and all Cargo.lock pins are unchanged.

native_build_environment.tool_preparation: APT download-only and private extraction; record every package version/SHA before compiling. Python build tools get a separate virtualenv and frozen version record. Cargo.lock is checked and not refreshed.
native_build_environment.openssl_linkage: Shared libssl.so.3/libcrypto.so.3 already present in the exact pinned image; record their SHA256. Private development symlinks only, no installed package change. Every completed wheel must pass a fresh native-extension import.

value_hypothesis.bottleneck: The native binding policy forgets a 33000-character prefix across one eviction interval, while the actual fixed-history GPU prompt is 42377 characters. This can choose a cold physical owner even when another rank holds a shared prefix.
value_hypothesis.plausible_benefit: Preserve useful placement knowledge across replay delays. The existing C128 point initially computes 160.09M prefill tokens, but text sharing does not quantify removable work or end-to-end gain.
value_hypothesis.cheapest_useful_experiment: First private ARM build preflight, then the same delayed CPU cases using its wheel. Require preserved hash/body controls and retained long-prefix ownership. Only then run the unchanged ten real-model owner/numerical cases and a fresh C128 full hour if qualified.
value_hypothesis.cost: One source constant, a locked native CPU build, existing CPU and GPU probes, and a full replay only after qualification. Reuse the current holder while useful. Pause CPU compilation during the separate profile scoring interval. No new GPU allocation for preparation.
